nodes.name: DonationsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin dashboard page listing all Pāvati donations for the active trust with search, payment-mode, status, and category filters plus PDF receipt downloads.

nodes.name: DonationsPage
nodes.summary: Renders a filterable, paginated donations table with permission-aware actions and per-row receipt PDF download.

nodes.name: LandingPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public landing/marketing page for Pāvati Pustak with hero, feature grid, how-it-works steps, and a decorative receipt mockup; redirects logged-in users to the dashboard.

nodes.name: LandingPage
nodes.summary: Renders the marketing hero, features, and onboarding steps, redirecting authenticated users to /app.

nodes.name: CommitteePage.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the trust committee grouped by role, showing members who hold administrative positions with their profile images and positions.

nodes.name: CommitteePage
nodes.summary: Fetches and renders the trust committee partitioned by committee role.

nodes.name: MembersPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Member management page allowing search, add/invite, role and position updates, permission toggles, and member removal across the active trust.

nodes.name: MembersPage
nodes.summary: Renders the members list with add/invite and edit modals and mutations for adding, updating roles, inviting, and removing members.

nodes.name: NotificationsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Shows the notification outbox with per-channel status along with WhatsApp/email channel preference toggles for auto-sending receipt notifications.

nodes.name: NotificationsPage
nodes.summary: Renders the paged notification outbox and editable channel settings with a save mutation.

nodes.name: CreateTrustWizard.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-step onboarding wizard for creating a new trust, collecting trust details, festivals, join mode, and contact info with logo upload, then displaying generated join and unique codes.

nodes.name: CreateTrustWizard
nodes.summary: Three-step wizard (trust details, festivals & join, done) that submits trust creation, uploads logo, and sets the new trust as active.

nodes.name: JoinTrustPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Lets a user join a trust by entering a join code, looking up the trust details and posting a join request, then refreshing the session.

nodes.name: JoinTrustPage
nodes.summary: Looks up a trust by join code and submits a join request, handling approval-pending and success states.

nodes.name: OnboardingPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Onboarding hub listing the user's existing trusts (to switch active trust) with links to create a new trust or find and join one.

nodes.name: OnboardingPage
nodes.summary: Renders the onboarding entry screen listing memberships and entry cards to create or join a trust.

nodes.name: TrustSearchPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public trust search page allowing users to search trusts by name or city, view them, and join open or approval-mode trusts.

nodes.name: TrustSearchPage
nodes.summary: Searches trusts and handles joining them, refreshing memberships on success.

nodes.name: ReceiptPreviewPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page that loads a single receipt and displays its generated PDF inline with a download button.

nodes.name: ReceiptPreviewPage
nodes.summary: Fetches a receipt by ID and renders its PDF in an iframe with download support.

nodes.name: ReceiptVerifyPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public receipt verification page that validates a receipt by a security token, showing its authenticity and an embedded PDF, or an error if invalid.

nodes.name: ReceiptVerifyPage
nodes.summary: Verifies a receipt token via the API and renders verified details or a not-found error state.

nodes.name: ReceiptsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Receipt management page listing generated Pāvati receipts with search, status filter, PDF download, and WhatsApp/email sending to donors.

nodes.name: ReceiptsPage
nodes.summary: Renders the receipts table with filtering, per-receipt PDF download, and channel-aware send controls.

nodes.name: SendPopover
nodes.summary: Popover that lets a user send a receipt via WhatsApp or email, opening WhatsApp links or invoking an onSend callback for selected channels.

nodes.name: ReportsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Donation reporting dashboard with summary stat cards, daily collection and payment-mode charts (recharts), category allocation, and collector performance bars, plus CSV export.

nodes.name: ReportsPage
nodes.summary: Loads summary, daily, and collector report data, renders charts and stat cards, and triggers CSV export.

nodes.name: TrustSettingsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Trust settings editor for basic details, join code display, membership join mode, contact/location info, festivals, and a guarded danger zone to permanently delete the trust.

nodes.name: TrustSettingsPage
nodes.summary: Loads and saves trust settings, uploads logos, copies the join code, and handles confirmed permanent trust deletion for primary admins.

nodes.name: TemplateEditorPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Visual receipt template editor with page-size controls, background image upload, field list management, a draggable field overlay, and a live receipt preview.

nodes.name: TemplateEditorPage
nodes.summary: Manages template editing including page size, field configs, background upload, save/create via API, and live preview rendering.

nodes.name: TemplatesPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Lists Pāvati receipt templates with visual previews, showing active/inactive status and actions to edit, activate, delete, or create new templates.

nodes.name: TemplatesPage
nodes.summary: Renders template cards with activate/delete mutations and a link to create new templates.

nodes.name: TrustPublicProfile.tsx
nodes.summary: Public trust profile page showing trust details, member/stat cards, committee, recent donors, and join/donate actions based on auth state.

nodes.name: TrustPublicProfile
nodes.summary: Loads public trust data and renders its profile with committee, recent donations, and conditional join/donate actions.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Central HTTP client for the web app: token management, fetch wrapper with automatic refresh on 401, REST helpers (get/post/patch/del), file upload, receipt PDF download, and CSV export.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Error class carrying an HTTP status code and optional details, thrown on failed API requests.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Performs an authenticated fetch, transparently refreshing the access token once on a 401 response and retrying the original request.

nodes.name: downloadReceiptPdf
nodes.summary: Fetches a receipt PDF as a blob and triggers a browser download.

nodes.name: exportDonationsCsv
nodes.summary: Fetches a trust's donations export CSV and triggers a browser download.

nodes.name: uploadFile
nodes.summary: Uploads a data URL (image or pdf) to the server and returns the resulting URL.

nodes.name: getReceiptPdfUrl
nodes.summary: Fetches a receipt PDF blob and returns an object URL for inline display.

nodes.name: auth-actions.ts
nodes.summary: Logout helpers that revoke the refresh token via the API, clear local tokens, reset the auth store, and optionally navigate to the login page.

nodes.name: performLogout
nodes.summary: Posts a logout with the refresh token, clears tokens, and resets the auth store.

nodes.name: useLogout
nodes.summary: React hook returning a logout function that also navigates to the login page.

nodes.name: festivals.ts
nodes.summary: Festival and donation category helpers combining default categories with a trust's custom festivals, plus a hook to fetch a trust's festival types.

nodes.name: categoryOptions
nodes.summary: Builds a de-duplicated list of category options from default donation categories merged with trust festivals.

nodes.name: useTrustFestivals
nodes.summary: Hook that queries and returns a trust's festival types via react-query.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand auth store holding the user, memberships, and active trust ID, with session/trust setters, logout, and a useActiveTrust selector.

nodes.name: useActiveTrust
nodes.summary: Selector hook returning the currently active membership or the first membership, or null.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: General frontend utilities: class-name merging, INR/date formatting re-exports, relative time strings, file-to-data-URL reading, and blob downloads.

nodes.name: timeAgo
nodes.summary: Formats a date as a human-readable relative time such as '5m ago' or '3d ago'.

nodes.name: fileToDataUrl
nodes.summary: Reads a File into a data URL string using FileReader.

nodes.name: downloadBlob
nodes.summary: Triggers a browser download of a blob with a given filename.
